rationale: This mutation eliminates the $9,500 cash gap by compressing the early Carrot bootstrap to a single cycle harvested on Day 3 morning, immediately transitioning all acreage to hyper-fertilized Strawberries to capture 7-8 lifetime recurring flushes per plot instead of 5-6. It enforces a strict 22-24 plot land cap frozen at Day 13 synchronized with 10-11 hands (~2.0-2.2 plots/hand), abolishing 75% backpack gating and pre-harvest well detours to streamline micro-dispatch. Furthermore, it raises the uncontracted surplus liquidation trigger to 14 items (shed used >= 36) to preserve inventory for 2.0x-3.5x Town Shop arbitrage, bans low-margin endgame Carrot backfills, and executes synchronized terminal shed clearance across steps 706-718.
